chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There is no servant who passes his hand over the head of an orphan out of compassion for him except that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, grants him a light for every hair on the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.نُورًا: light, a reward and illumination in the hereafter
key_terms.يَتِيمٍ: an orphan, a child without paternal support

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for showing compassion to an orphan in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of showing tenderness and mercy to an orphan. It promises a great reward in the afterlife, as Allah grants light on the Day of Judgment for this compassionate act.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.570 – Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"There is no servant who passes their hand over the head of an orphan out of compassion for them except that Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, grants them a light for every strand of hair (they touch) on the Day of Judgment."
